description: This file implements the MiscService class for a modem simulator, handling timezone parsing, command initialization, and specific command handling such as IMEI retrieval and time updates.

classes.name: MiscService
classes.description: A class that provides miscellaneous services for a modem simulator, including timezone management and command handling.

methods.name: MiscService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service and parses the timezone.

methods.name: ParseTimeZone
methods.description: Reads the timezone from the system file /etc/timezone on Linux systems.

methods.name: FixTimeZone
methods.description: Replaces '/' with '!' in timezone strings to conform to expected format.

methods.name: SetTimeZone
methods.description: Sets the timezone after fixing its format.

methods.name: InitializeCommandHandlers
methods.description: Initializes command handlers for various AT commands supported by the service.

methods.name: HandleGetIMEI
methods.description: Handles the AT+CGSN command to retrieve IMEI and related information.

methods.name: HandleTimeUpdate
methods.description: Handles the remote time update command.

methods.name: TimeZoneOffset
methods.description: Calculates the timezone offset in seconds.

methods.name: TimeUpdate
methods.description: Generates and sends a time update unsolicited response.
